panel.linkNote: Broken link, or a link pointing outside the project
panel.truncated: This folder has more items; showing the first {count}.

panel.enlargeTitle: Enlarge: show the file at window size

media.imageFailed: Couldn't show the image: the file is damaged or in a format the built-in viewer doesn't know.
media.fitImage: Fit the image to the panel
media.showActualSize: Show the image at actual size
media.codecFailed: This {noun} can't be played in Kokpit: the built-in player can't decode the file's codec (e.g. ProRes or HEVC). {what}. Kokpit doesn't convert files; exported as H.264/AAC (.mp4) or VP9/Opus (.webm), it will play.
media.readFailed: Couldn't read the file (the connection dropped or the file changed). {what}. Use ↻ Reload to try again.
media.noPicture: Can't decode the picture's codec (e.g. ProRes or HEVC); only the sound plays. {what}. Kokpit doesn't convert files.
